question.text: A client reviews an IPS and finds the PM has exceeded tactical bands (e.g., equity at 75% vs a 60-70% SAA band). The client should:

answer.text: Require action under the IPS rebalancing policy or restoration to target weights, escalating to grievance or ODR mechanisms if unresolved
File a SEBI complaint immediately without first invoking the IPS

explanation.text: The Logic: The IPS sets a rebalancing policy with a tolerance for deviation from the target policy portfolio and requires monitoring drift and rebalancing back to desired exposures. If the issue cannot be resolved through this policy, the client can use the separately described grievance and dispute-resolution mechanisms. The Trap: Ignoring the breach or jumping straight to a SEBI complaint skips the contractually agreed rebalancing and dispute-resolution steps. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.152, p.153, p.175, p.395, and p.396).
